# pdf-lib 1.17.1

Unmodified `dist/pdf-lib.min.js` from the installed official npm package `pdf-lib`, version 1.17.1. The MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.

- Project: https://pdf-lib.js.org/
- Source and release: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/releases/tag/v1.17.1

The CX action-plan exporter loads this file from the site's own origin only when a visitor requests a PDF. The library creates a new document from trusted local copy; it does not accept uploaded PDFs, transmit checklist answers or contact an external conversion service.
